plan.fit: Maximize macro holdout accuracy on training subjects within their seeded lookup total. Break ties by lower cost and declared order. Hold out both model panels and every seed of each subject. Also fit one rule on the other full benchmark family.
plan.gate: Require a positive paired lower endpoint for the learned opening rule against original CPO and the trained blind rule, with realized lookup cost within seeded CPO on every cohort.
plan.rule: Choose one search for the entire episode after the first two seeded incumbent reads. Both searches must already pay for those same reads. The opening mask specifies how many incumbent passes permit the full four-anchor race. Candidate rules may activate fixed eighths inside those strata. A hash-rate control uses the same bins without reading scores.
